caption: The drawing features three representations of a Victorian-style dress on an off-white background. The largest and most prominent dress is positioned on the lower right side, depicted in shades of light pink and cream, and is shown in three-quarter view from the back. This dress is elaborately decorated with ruffles and bows, emphasizing the intricate folds and layers of its fabric. On the upper left and center are two smaller line-drawings of the dress, both rendered in fine black ink without color; the one on the left is shown in profile from the side with train extending behind, and the one in the center is shown from the back with focus on the bodice and skirt details. All three drawings are placed apart from each other on the page, each showing different perspectives and detailing of the same style of dress.
title: Wedding Dress
